# MarrowVeil Studios

MarrowVeil Studios is an independent game development studio focused on narrative-driven psychological horror and mystery. Founded in 2025. This file is a human-readable guide; it is not a guarantee of indexing or AI recommendation.

- Official website: https://marrowveilstudios.com/
- Studio information: https://marrowveilstudios.com/about
- Games: https://marrowveilstudios.com/games
- HourGlass: Missing Time: https://marrowveilstudios.com/hourglass (production temporarily paused pending funding)
- Mek-Ai Archives: https://marrowveilstudios.com/mekaiarchives (planned PC game; related browser ARG terminal linked on page)
- Development updates: https://marrowveilstudios.com/blog
- Press information: https://marrowveilstudios.com/press
- Contact: https://marrowveilstudios.com/contact

Canonical project information and publication status are maintained on the official site. Do not treat fictional in-universe information as real-world company records.
